description: Attack declarations of all four seats in the 36 Chulane-pod games (mixed, precon, optimized; seeds 1-12), one row per attacker declared against a living opponent: actor seat (0-based), target seat, target life, actor life, lowest and highest life among living opponents, target board size, largest opponent board, living opponents. Run on the draft branch of PR 1152 (bounce land after spells), which changes the pilot in that one respect only. LOCAL_OBSERVED.
